observations.classification: Conditional historical first-party/native arithmetic bridge; existing rig admission CONTRACT-029 already recognizes native zero-width, unique count and alias unresolved.
observations.trace: Historical validate_tier checks the four configured grass fade endpoints finite/nonnegative and nondecreasing using <=. Batch spawn passes configured_tier_visibility_range directly to InstanceMaterialData; historical grass material selects the custom vertex shader and native pipeline source adds VISIBILITY_RANGE_DITHER. That vertex shader calls the native dither function, which selects xy before z and divides by (y−x), or zw at/after z and divides by (w−z). Assuming a complete otherwise accepted config with xy=(0,0), zw=(10,20), active shader definition, draw and camera distance in (0,10), the selected denominator is zero. This mathematical branch is not a constructed fixture or proof of full-config admission, actual GPU behavior, rendered artifact, target-specific float-to-int outcome or current 95e defect.

observations.classification: Conditional historical native shader geometric question; reachability and alias open.
observations.trace: The generic native vertex shader multiplies a normal by final_matrix, while utils composes the arbitrary parent world_from_local with a local uniform scale/yaw/translation. A nonuniform parent such as diag(2,1,1) maps input normal (1,1,0) to (2,1,0), which is not orthogonal to the transformed tangent (2,−1,0); an inverse-transpose normal would preserve orthogonality. This is algebra only, with no shader execution. A supported caller selecting the generic shader with nonuniform parent and VERTEX_NORMALS is unestablished; inspected historic grass and shrub batches use default transforms and grass selects its own vertex shader.
observations.future_direction: After audit gate, establish actual supported transformations and shader selections, relate to any existing normal-transform owner, then preserve proper normal frame handling only where needed; no current project alias assumed.
